metadata.description: volkstrader's Claude Code skills and mods, forked from johnnyvizz/claude-kit, robonuggets/ribbon and data-goblin/claude-code-filetree (all MIT).

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill: plan, delegate to tiered worker subagents, review.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel; made for savvy-flow, shows any subagents.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Mod: band above the prompt with turn, speed, cost, prompt cache countdown and context; notifies before the cache expires.

plugins.name: ribbon
plugins.description: Mod: a slim band above the prompt with usage left, reset times, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold with what the next message costs.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Mod: IDE-style file tree pane of the session cwd with git status, lines changed, and a shimmer on files Claude reads, writes and commits.
